title: UI风格#196 - Retro Arcade (复古街机)
description: 创建第196种UI风格：复古街机风格 - 80年代街机游戏、像素艺术、霓虹灯光。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGN.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When color palette Then features arcade neon, black, CRT glow
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FF0055 (街机红), #00FF00 (街机绿), #FFFF00 (街机黄), #000000 (黑), #FF00FF (品红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When typography Then uses pixel: Press Start 2P, Silkscreen
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Press Start 2P (像素), Silkscreen (丝印)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When layout Then pixel art borders, arcade cabinet feel, high score display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：像素艺术边框、街机柜感受、高分显示

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When UI elements Then pixel animations, joystick feel, 8-bit sounds
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：像素动画、摇杆感、8位音效

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade UI When functional Then includes game chat, player agents, score stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：游戏聊天、玩家代理、得分统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade UI When copy Then uses arcade: 'Insert Coin', 'Game Over', 'High Score'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'INSERT COIN TO PLAY'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'PLAY'、'DEPLOY'→'START'
